# HttpProtect.isLimited() method

Whether an address is currently over the 429 threshold.

**Signature:**

```typescript
isLimited(ip: string): Promise<boolean>;
```

## Parameters

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;boolean&gt;

`true` if its live counter exceeds [HttpProtect.maxRequests](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.maxrequests/)<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Read-only: it neither counts the call nor refreshes the counter's TTL. A missing key reads as zero, so an address that has been quiet for [HttpProtect.ttl](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.ttl/) reports `false`<!-- -->.

It does not consult the block list, so a banned address reports `false` here once its counter lapses. Check [HttpProtect.isBanned()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.isbanned/) as well to get the whole picture.
